news.headline: David Montgomery Could Miss Time With Groin Injury
news.summary: Montgomery (groin) was ruled out for Houston's Week 6 London win over Jacksonville and still has no confirmed Week 7 return against the Giants, so Marks keeps the Texans' early-down role for now.

news.headline: Quinshon Judkins' injury woes continue after missing second day of practice
news.summary: Judkins was again held out of Browns practice for a second straight day this week with his ankle issue, leaving his Week 7 status against Tennessee unresolved heading into the weekend.

news.headline: Hunter Henry Becoming Reliable Red-Zone Weapon for Patriots
news.summary: Henry caught a 7-yard, game-winning touchdown in New England's 26-19 Week 6 win over the Jets, his second score in as many weeks after not finding the end zone through the first four games.

news.headline: Dameon Pierce's Heavy Workload Makes Him a Week 7 Waiver Priority
news.summary: Pierce played a career-high 61 snaps and logged 16 touches in Philadelphia's Week 6 loss with Saquon Barkley out, and projects as the Eagles' clear lead back again in Week 7 against Dallas.

news.headline: 49ers' Nick Bosa Reveals Health Status for Huge Week 7 Showdown
news.summary: Bosa (calf) said he's targeting this Week 7 game at Atlanta as his return after sitting out Week 6, though the 49ers haven't officially confirmed his status yet.

news.headline: Fab's Five Fantasy Football Defense Streamers: Start the Browns DST in Week 7
news.summary: Cleveland's defense draws a Tennessee offense averaging just 3.6 points per game at home this week, making the Browns one of the top streaming options.

news.headline: Tank Bigsby to Undergo Core-Muscle Surgery, Set to Hit Injured Reserve
news.summary: Bigsby underwent core-muscle surgery and landed on IR with an abdomen injury; the earliest he's eligible to return is Week 9 against the Giants.

news.headline: Saints place RB Travis Etienne (hamstring) on IR
news.summary: Etienne was placed on injured reserve with a hamstring injury suffered in Week 3 and isn't eligible to return until at least Week 9.
